857:t_1:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Welcome to the world of '3rd Super Robot Wars Z'.」

857:t_1:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm $$西条涼音$$, and I'll be your guide for this Guidance Scenario.」

857:t_1:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm still studying to become a teacher, but I'll do my best to be as helpful to all of you as I can.」

857:t_1:8.en:
$$スズネ$$
「A student in the class I'm in charge of for my teaching practicum, $$ヒビキ・カミシロ$$.」

857:t_1:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「He'll be serving as my assistant.」

857:t_1:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Good, good. You've really developed a sense of yourself as a guide. At this rate, I think you'll stop being the quiet type before long.」

857:t_1:12.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「If you put it that way, I'll have to give it my all.」

857:t_1:13.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「Then let me give everyone two pieces of advice for playing.」

857:t_1:15.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「'When in trouble, press the SELECT button' and 'When you don't understand something, check the Lecture Plates'... Those are the keys to victory.」

857:t_1:16.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「The SELECT button can bring up key help, meaning the control explanations, in all sorts of situations.」

857:t_1:17.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「Also, on the robot and pilot status screens, it can bring up explanations of any abilities or spirit commands you don't understand.」

857:t_1:18.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And the other one, the 'Lecture Plates'?」

857:t_1:19.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「The 'Lecture Plates' are what explain this game's systems.」

857:t_1:20.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「Put the cursor on a map tile with no allies or enemies and press the SELECT button to bring up the 'Combat Record'. Inside it...」

857:t_1:22.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So if I look at those, I can read the explanations of the game systems.」

857:t_1:23.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「This '3rd Super Robot Wars Z Tengoku-hen' is based on its predecessor, '3rd Super Robot Wars Z Jigoku-hen', but...」

857:t_1:24.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「there are all sorts of improved and added systems. Please check those out in the 'Lecture Plates' too.」

857:t_1:25.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Well then, practice makes perfect, as they say... Let's jump right into field training on a battle map.」

857:t_2:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Good work, $$ヒビキ$$. Now I'll explain the Intermission.」

857:t_2:4.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「The Intermission is a part that exists apart from the story, where you save your game data, prepare for the next scenario, and so on...」

857:t_2:5.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「The team setup for the Tag Battle System is done there too... Right?」

857:t_2:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And in '3rd Super Robot Wars Z Tengoku-hen', 'Support' under 'Team Setup' has 'Lecture Plates' for the Intermission.」

857:t_2:8.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「So if I look there, I can see explanations of all sorts of systems, just like on the map.」

857:t_2:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Make good use of those and do your best, okay?」

857:t_2:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everyone in front of your monitors...」

857:t_2:12.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This Guidance Scenario has only introduced the basics of the vast world of '3rd Super Robot Wars Z'.」

857:t_2:13.en:
$$スズネ$$
「From here on, please see everything this world has to offer with your own eyes.」

857:t_2:14.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And please look forward to seeing how much $$ヒビキ$$ grows in the main story, too.」

857:t_2:16.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm wishing you all the best in your battles. Now, see you in the main story.」

858:t_000:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Now then, everyone. Please control the allied team of the $$デルタプラス$$ and $$リゼル$$ and wipe out the enemies.」

858:t_000:1.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「I recommend trying out all sorts of commands, such as spirit commands and boost parts.」

858:t_000:2.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「Like I said earlier, if you don't understand the game's systems, put the cursor on a tile with no allies or enemies...」

858:t_000:3.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「press the SELECT button to bring up the 'Combat Record', and read the 'Lecture Plates' in there.」

858:t_000:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This scenario has no defeat conditions. I've set it up so allied units revive even when they're shot down, so I recommend treating it like practice and trying all sorts of things.」

858:t_000:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I've specially filled the allied pilots' Spirit Points to the brim, so please try out lots of spirit commands too.」

858:t_001:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You even earned SR Points. Impressive.」

858:t_002:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Good work. I think you now have a general idea of how to play.」

858:t_003:1.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「There was an item called '???' in the Lecture Plates...」

858:t_003:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's the explanation for systems that get added as the game progresses. See for yourself which systems get added.」

858:t_003:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everyone... The real battles are more complex than this Guidance Scenario and the enemies are tougher, but there's nothing to worry about.」

858:t_003:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If you move forward while checking what you can do one step at a time, you're sure to clear it.」

858:t_003:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And with that, the battle map guidance is over. Next is the Intermission explanation.」

858:t_004:0.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「The $$デルタプラス$$ has been shot down!」

858:t_004:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Since this is the Guidance Scenario, I'll revive it as a special exception.」

858:t_005:0.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「The $$リゼル$$ has been shot down!」

858:t_005:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Since this is the Guidance Scenario, I'll revive it as a special exception.」

858:t_006:0.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「The team has been wiped out!」

858:t_006:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Since this is the Guidance Scenario, I'll revive it as a special exception.」

858:t_007:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What matters in this Guidance Scenario is getting a feel for SRW, so don't be afraid to take on the challenge.」

858:t_007:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Even if you get shot down, I'll revive you as a special exception.」

858:t_007:2.en:
$$ヒビキ$$
「Don't be afraid of failure, and do your best.」

uncertain: Game title rendered '3rd Super Robot Wars Z' / '3rd Super Robot Wars Z Tengoku-hen' / previous game '... Jigoku-hen' (per batch-12 brief; 時獄篇 read Jigoku-hen).
UI terms from the Jigoku UI translations: Combat Record, Lecture Plates, SR Points, Tag Battle System, Team Setup (チーム編成), spirit commands, boost parts (強化パーツ).
857:t_2:7: 'Support' under 'Team Setup' for サポート menu name is a guess (UI may name it differently).
857:t_1:12: 張り切る line rendered 'I'll have to give it my all' (Hibiki's polite deadpan).
858:t_001:1: ＳＲポイント獲得 praise addressed to the player; 858:t_004-006/007:1 'revive it/them/you' object supplied (unit/team).
